descriptor.scene: A wide three-plot frame across the plain, a year on, late golden afternoon. On the LEFT, the sprinter's tower stands wrapped in repair scaffolding from ground to crown, cloth patches and braces on its hollow floors, one tiny distant figure near its base tending the repairs. In the MIDDLE, a dark empty plot: untouched grass, nothing built, one tiny distant figure standing at its edge. On the RIGHT, Maya's tower, the tallest of the three and visibly solid: clean straight lines, finished edges, warm lit windows, floor after completed floor, rising confidently with a neat crane still working at its top. Maya herself stands tiny at its base, her closed silver laptop under her left arm, looking up at her own work. Nobody is mocked: the light falls kindly on all three plots. The lower right of the frame, beside the base of Maya's tower, stays calm golden grass.
negatives: the scaffolded tower collapsing or ruined (it is under repair, not destroyed)
any figure close enough to have a readable face (all figures including Maya are tiny at this distance)
descriptor._caption: A year passes. The tower of the founder who sprinted stands wrapped in repairs he can no longer afford. The plot of the founder who waited is still dark. And Maya's tower is rising faster than either of them ever moved, floor after solid floor.
